time.arrival_model: seeded bursty cluster process with a daily rhythm curve

collision_method: Brute-force over unused neutral identifiers; pick the first device and card whose three default-filter positions (m=512, k=3) were already set when the control event was replayed. The control is not inserted because it is clean and allowed.
